name: Fundamentals of Computer Science 1
description: Introduces design recipes, data definitions, and recursion. Foundation for the CS sequence.

name: Fundamentals of Computer Science 2
description: Continues the recipe-driven design approach with abstraction, generics, and an intro to OOP.

name: Logic and Computation
description: Mathematical reasoning about programs using ACL2; induction, proofs, and formal correctness.

name: Algorithms and Data
description: Asymptotic analysis, divide and conquer, dynamic programming, graphs, NP-completeness.

name: Object-Oriented Design
description: Design patterns, refactoring, MVC, and large-scale OO architecture in Java.

name: Computer Systems
description: C, memory, processes, virtual memory, concurrency, file systems, and networking.

name: Networks and Distributed Systems
description: TCP/IP, routing, RPC, consensus, distributed storage, and fault tolerance.

name: Theory of Computation
description: Automata, languages, computability, and complexity classes.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Search, knowledge representation, planning, and intro reinforcement learning.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: Tokenization, parsing, language models, embeddings, and modern transformer-based NLP.

name: Game AI
description: AI techniques for games: pathfinding, decision-making, learning agents.

name: Computer Graphics
description: Rasterization, ray tracing, shaders, and modern rendering pipelines.

name: Computer Graphics 2
description: Advanced rendering, geometry processing, animation, and GPU computing.

name: Software Development
description: Build a real product in teams — engineering process, tests, and code review.

name: Mobile App Development
description: Native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin/Compose); persistence, networking, sensors.

name: Web Development
description: Full-stack JavaScript: React, Node, Express, MongoDB; auth and deployment.

name: Robotic Science and Systems
description: Sensors, actuators, kinematics, and SLAM on real robot platforms.

name: Network Fundamentals
description: Deep dive into TCP/IP, QUIC, BGP, and network performance.

name: Software Vulnerabilities and Security
description: Buffer overflows, web vulns, fuzzing, and secure coding practices.

name: Systems Security
description: OS-level attacks and defenses; exploit mitigations, sandboxing, and trusted computing.

name: Programming with Data
description: Python for data: pandas, numpy, plotting, intro to data engineering.

name: Intermediate Programming with Data
description: Statistical thinking, regression, classification, and data pipelines.

name: Foundations of Data Science
description: ML foundations: linear models, evaluation, feature engineering.

name: Advanced Programming with Data
description: Software engineering for data: APIs, OOP, testing, and architecture.

name: Machine Learning and Data Mining 1
description: Supervised learning: SVMs, decision trees, ensembles, and model selection.

name: Machine Learning and Data Mining 2
description: Unsupervised learning, dimensionality reduction, neural nets, and deep learning.

name: Foundations of Cybersecurity
description: CIA triad, cryptography basics, threat modeling, and ethical hacking.

name: Systems Security
description: Cross-listed with CS 4830 — OS-level attacks and defenses.

name: Network Security Practices
description: TLS, firewalls, IDS/IPS, and incident response.

name: Cryptography
description: Symmetric and public-key crypto, hash functions, and modern protocols.

name: Calculus 1 for Science/Engineering
description: Limits, derivatives, applications, and an intro to integration.

name: Calculus 2 for Science/Engineering
description: Techniques of integration, series, and parametric/polar coordinates.

name: Linear Algebra
description: Vectors, matrices, eigenvectors, and linear transformations.

name: Probability and Statistics
description: Probability distributions, estimators, hypothesis testing, and confidence intervals.

name: Embedded Design
description: C programming for microcontrollers; ARM Cortex-M and embedded peripherals.

name: Fundamentals of Electronics
description: Analog and digital electronics, op-amps, and PCB design.

name: Computer Architecture
description: Pipelines, caches, memory hierarchy, and SIMD.

name: First-Year Writing
description: Academic writing fundamentals, argumentation, and revision.

name: Advanced Writing in the Disciplines
description: Discipline-specific genre writing for technical and professional contexts.

name: Tech and Human Values
description: Ethics of technology, AI, privacy, and engineering responsibility.

name: Ethics of AI
description: Algorithmic fairness, accountability, transparency, and AI governance.

name: Foundations of Psychology
description: Survey of cognitive, social, and clinical psychology.

name: Human-Computer Interaction
description: Usability, prototyping, and user research methods.

name: Information Design Studio
description: Visualizing data and complex systems with editorial design principles.

name: Interaction Design Studio
description: Designing interactive products: research, prototyping, and motion.

name: Husky Hidden Histories
description: Cross-cultural perspectives on the history of Northeastern and Boston.

name: Foundations of Journalism
description: Reporting, interviewing, and writing for digital newsrooms.

name: The Entrepreneurial Mindset
description: Opportunity recognition, lean startup, and prototyping ventures.

name: Business and Society
description: Foundational management, organizational behavior, and ethics.
